criteria: Original copied/adapted items retain arithmetic value but do not establish unseen generation.
Generation inputs must exclude the reference and prior verdicts; record shared filesystem rather than claim OS-enforced isolation.
Each F item needs signed net force and acceleration under a stipulated model and positive mass.
Each U item needs millimetre-to-metre conversion and the factor relation.
Producer self-judgment is SELF-ASSESSED; separate assessment still shares supplied model assumptions.
Use actual canonical assignment/tracker mapping rather than silently replacing IDs.
checks_planned: Inspect issued input set and full-file byte hashes.
Derive numeric claims from generated givens with exact arithmetic where feasible.
Assess the distinct claim of reproduction versus transfer and retain learner acceptance unverified.
limits: These expectations can be falsified by actual inputs; they are not a hidden authoritative answer key or model qualification.
